paragraphs: The holy congregation in Jerusalem: this is R' Yosi ben Meshullam and R' Shimon ben Menasya (see there). R’ Yehoshua ben Levi said that Rabbi said in the name of the holy congregation: Yoma 69a:6; Rosh Hashanah 19b. R' Yosi ben Shaul said that Rabbi said in the holy congregation's name: Beitzah 14, end of b, 27a; Yoma 69a:6 and Tamid 27b:3 [the chains differ]. R' Yosi ben Elyakim testified in the holy congregation's name: Berakhot 9b. In Jerusalem Talmud, Ma’aser Sheni 2:4:3 [Heilprin writes בס״ב]: ‘holy assembly’—R' Yosi ben Meshullam and R' Shimon ben Menasya. In Kohelet Rabbah, on ‘Enjoy life with the wife,’ Rabbi in the holy assembly's name: why were they called ‘holy assembly’? Because they divided the day into thirds: one third for prayer, one third for Torah, and one third for work. In the Arukh: they labored in Torah during winter and at work in summer.
